description.purpose: Investigate a delivered-not-received order, open a carrier trace, and record replacement and pickup preferences without prematurely creating a replacement.

user_scenario.persona: Ethan Patel is a polite but time-pressed apartment dweller whose order of blue noise-canceling headphones was scanned delivered but never arrived. The headphones are a gift and he is flying out Friday around noon, so he needs them in hand by Thursday. He has already checked his building's front desk and package room twice.

instructions.task_instructions: Call Westline customer care about order 7319, which shows delivered but was never received. Provide the order number and email when asked. When asked about the building, explain it is an apartment building with a front desk and a package room, that you checked both last night and this morning, that the attendant found no driver signature around the scan time, and that there is no delivery photo in the email. Stress the time pressure: the headphones are a gift, you fly out Friday around noon, and Thursday delivery would be ideal. Ask what the trace means for timing, whether a replacement goes out automatically, and insist any replacement be the exact same blue model at your original price. Ask to have a replacement sent somewhere other than your building and name the West 23rd Street pickup counter. Ask what happens if the package turns up before or after a replacement ships, and ask for the case number so you are not double-charged. Confirm when the trace email arrives and read back the deadline you see. Do not accept a refund; you want the item.
instructions.known_info: Order reference 7319; email ethan.patel@northmail.com; item is a pair of blue noise-canceling headphones; the building has a front desk and package room, both checked with nothing held; no driver signature around the scan time; no delivery photo in the email; travel departure Friday 2026-08-28 around noon; Thursday 2026-08-27 is the ideal in-hand date; preferred alternate pickup is the West 23rd Street pickup counter; the black variant is priced differently now.
instructions.unknown_info: Where the package actually is; that the carrier scan shows a near-building location with no unit, locker, or photo and a possible misscan; whether the blue variant is in stock; the trace case number, deadline, and approval process; whether pickup fulfillment will be available for a replacement.

actions.name: get_order
actions.info: Verify the order reference and email match before disclosing delivery details, and review the delivered scan.

actions.name: get_order
actions.info: Pull detailed carrier evidence (near-building scan, no unit/locker/photo, possible misscan) after recording the customer's building checks.

actions.name: get_product
actions.info: Check same-variant replacement inventory before discussing replacement options.

actions.name: open_delivery_trace
actions.info: Open the required delivered-not-received trace; returns case WST481662 with the 18:00-tomorrow carrier deadline and the approval requirement.

actions.name: update_case

arguments.note: Preserve exact blue variant and original price if replacement becomes eligible.

actions.info: Record the customer's replacement preference and pickup location on the correct case without creating a replacement.

actions.name: send_case_notification
actions.info: Send the trace confirmation with the approval link to the verified order email only after the customer agrees.

actions.name: get_order
actions.info: Confirm the email the customer received matches case WST481662 and that the notification shows delivered.

nl_assertions: The agent verifies the order reference and the email on the order before disclosing delivery, case, or notification details.
The agent records the building, front-desk, and package-room checks as customer-provided facts, not as carrier facts.
The agent states the trace status and the carrier response deadline exactly as returned by the tool.
The agent makes clear that a replacement is not automatic and requires the customer's approval after an eligibility trigger.
The agent does not create a replacement order or claim one has been created while the delivery trace is open.
The agent does not tell the customer they may keep the original package if it turns up; any disposition comes only from a returned resolution or a specialist.
The agent does not guarantee that the customer will not be charged again.
The agent does not state that the original price carries over to a replacement before an eligibility result confirms that treatment.
The agent records the West 23rd Street pickup preference without guaranteeing pickup availability.
The agent does not claim the trace email was sent, or describe its contents such as an approval link, before send_case_notification returns a successful status.
The agent does not give numeric tool-duration or email-arrival time estimates that no tool result supports.
